_meta.title: Backroom A+B — user rule application
user_rules: Check ambiguous source URLs and decide, without asking user to identify a location
General park/riverbank/road pin sufficient when exact meeting subsection is unknown
Compare possible duplicates; do not merge without proof
Exclude eight genuinely unidentifiable geographic entries
Exclude no site-specific source signal in previous twelve months; merely current shop opening/roadworks is not cruising evidence
Exclude confirmed closed/fundamentally rebuilt or repeated no-activity records
newly_verified_context: Gays-Cruising's Palazzina page lists Ca di Mazze as separate nearby spot, 0.2km apart
Gays-Cruising Sevelen spot page specifies Rheintal rest area Sargans direction
Nov 2025 report documents demolition and rebuild of Rheintal West
Public operators identify separate Wiśniowa Góra east and west motorway stops
Carrefour identifies separate Vallès Terrassa and Montserrat hypermarkets
